title: The canonical single-module union comparison diagram before two-out-of-three
statement: Let p:Y→B be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, let B,A be affine and let g:A→B. Let U,V be arbitrary opens of Y, and let N be a quasi-coherent module on U union V, flat over B. Assume StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen(p,g,T) for T=U,V,U intersection V [def-pc-standard-single-flat-counit-presentation-on-open]. Use standard derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Write a for the canonical union comparison [def-pc-standard-single-base-change-map]. Restrict N by literal tensorPullback along Scheme.homOfLE to each member and the overlap and write aU,aV,aUV for their canonical comparisons. There are distinguished triangles in D(O_A) with vertices (domain a, domain aU direct-sum domain aV, domain aUV) and (codomain a, codomain aU direct-sum codomain aV, codomain aUV), and a morphism with components exactly a, biprod.map(aU,aV), aUV. Each of aU,aV,aUV is invertible. No invertibility of a, no bounded union complex, and no factorization at a supplied union complex is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0DJ9, induction diagram; Tag 08BV, arbitrary two-open K-injective Mayer--Vietoris; Tag 08FE, restriction of direct image. Official online pages read 2026-10-14.

proof.text: For any subopen T≤W, identify tensor pullback of N along Y.homOfLE with ordinary restriction by uniqueness of left adjoints. Restriction preserves quasi-coherence. For relative flatness, test on an affine open of T, map it to its affine image in W, and identify the scalar action using appLE_appIso_inv. Transfer this flatness through the module isomorphism. Apply the presentation hypothesis to the restricted module. Its bounded-above flat complex is K-flat, so the pinned counit is invertible and its factorization makes the literal comparison invertible. Do this for U,V,U intersection V.

Obtain a morphism m:P→P′ of short exact complexes with six localized vertex identifications and three conjugacy identities from standardSingle_union_ses_presentation. Conjugate Q(P.f), Q(P.g) and triangleOfSESδ by these identifications to define the six displayed differentials. Triangle.isoMk identifies the resulting triangles with triangleOfSES hP and triangleOfSES hP′. The Mathlib distinguishedness theorem and transport along these triangle isomorphisms prove both distinguishedness assertions.

Conjugate DerivedCategory.triangleOfSES.map hP hP′ m by the two triangle isomorphisms. Its three components are the localized components of m conjugated by the six vertex identifications. The three presentation equations and inverse-hom cancellation identify them with the union comparison, the biproduct of the two member comparisons, and the overlap comparison. Naturality of the short exact boundary supplies the connecting square through triangleOfSES.map. Append the three isomorphism proofs from step 1.

proof_origin.place: Q4: Tag 0DJ9 induction diagram; flat-isomorphism step is proved, the short exact geometric comparison is isolated as new-pc-standard-single-union-ses-presentation; explicit transport of Mathlib triangleOfSES and triangleOfSES.map proves the triangle and connecting-square assembly.

lean.statement:
theorem standardSingleFlatCounitUnionTriangles
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    [IsAffine B] [IsAffine A] (g : A ⟶ B) (U V : Y.Opens)
    (N : (U ⊔ V).toScheme.Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hN : N.IsFlatOver ((U ⊔ V).ι ≫ p))
    (hPU : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g U)
    (hPV : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g V)
    (hPUV : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g (U ⊓ V)) :
    letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    let a := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap ((U ⊔ V).ι ≫ p) N g)
    let aU := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap (U.ι ≫ p)
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (Y.homOfLE le_sup_left) N) g)
    let aV := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap (V.ι ≫ p)
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (Y.homOfLE le_sup_right) N) g)
    let aUV := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap ((U ⊓ V).ι ≫ p)
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans le_sup_left)) N) g)
    ∃ (d₁ : a.left ⟶ aU.left ⊞ aV.left)
      (d₂ : aU.left ⊞ aV.left ⟶ aUV.left)
      (d₃ : aUV.left ⟶ a.left⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
      (d₁' : a.right ⟶ aU.right ⊞ aV.right)
      (d₂' : aU.right ⊞ aV.right ⟶ aUV.right)
      (d₃' : aUV.right ⟶ a.right⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk d₁ d₂ d₃ ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory A) ∧
      Triangle.mk d₁' d₂' d₃' ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory A) ∧
      ∃ φ : Triangle.mk d₁ d₂ d₃ ⟶ Triangle.mk d₁' d₂' d₃',
        φ.hom₁ = a.hom ∧ φ.hom₂ = biprod.map aU.hom aV.hom ∧ φ.hom₃ = aUV.hom ∧
        IsIso aU.hom ∧ IsIso aV.hom ∧ IsIso aUV.hom
